t: The Bosch Plus-3 SDS Plus shank masonry drill bit set provides essential drilling capabilities for tradespeople tackling demanding tasks on-site. These tungsten carbide-tipped hammer drill bits are engineered for use with SDS Plus rotary hammers, delivering exceptional durability when drilling concrete, reinforced concrete and masonry. The 4-flute dura design efficiently removes dust, preventing heat build-up and extending bit life. Manufactured from high-alloy steel with optimised hardening technology to withstand wear. They also provide additional resistance with indented cutting edges made from a Bosch-controlled carbide blend. Supplied in a sturdy case for organised storage and transport.
